newsitem.title: UK: THE PROTEUS COLUMN - Pruduct expertise, UNUM.
newsitem.headline: THE PROTEUS COLUMN - Pruduct expertise, UNUM.

text.p: Product expertise can be a crucial factor in the success of a global insurance operation, especially in some commercial/wholesale lines. Nothing demonstrates this more than the whirlwind success of Bermuda, whose new property catastrophe reinsurers have secured a global niche that cannot easily be replicated.

The Reinsurance Group of America's facultative life reinsurance expertise lets it compete for life reinsurance outside the U.S. Hartford Steam Boiler is unlikely to find its knowledge base in industrial power plants matched by any non-U.S. player as it expands globally. And Executive Risk, a writer of D&O liability, has a niche product expertise which could surprise many with its international success.

Product expertise for small commercial risks or personal lines can enable a niche to be exploited in an overseas market. Competitive advantage in product will not last long for most insurance offerings, except those requiring highly technical/professional expertise and judgement or large historical databases not readily available to others.
A very good example is UNUM, the leading group disability underwriter in the U.S. which used its expertise to give it an entry point in the UK.

UNUM is in a high value-added business because underwriting claims management is so difficult. If anything the disability business is getting tougher because of new disabilities and a growing number of questionable claims, and UNUM's product expertise should therefore help it maintain its competitive advantages for several years.

UNUM recently started operations in Japan and is exploring other countries such as Germany and Argentina. If they manage to deploy their expertise with the same skill, we may see it adding to its success in around two years time.
